people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

people.name: Ziklag
people.line: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's

translations.web: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South, and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag, and burned it with fire,
translations.bsb: On the third day David and his men arrived in Ziklag, and the Amalekites had raided the Negev, attacked Ziklag, and burned it down.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had made a raid upon the South, and upon Ziklag, and had smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire,
